title: Volume Dial
description: A big volume dial for Here Comes the Sun. The cover stays upright while a knurled grip turns around it, the scale lights tick by tick and clicks at every ten, the cover drains to grey as you turn it down, and hitting 100 lands with a single thump.
intent: A music-app volume control finished to the edge: crisp ticks, a physical grip, honest numbers and one small payoff at full volume.
